digest.component_or_area: Plan Review pass structure & prompt caching
propositions: Pass-1 and verifier prompts must share a byte-identical prefix containing the full plan to enable Anthropic's ephemeral cache reuse across passes within the same run.
The plan must move into the verifier system prompt (via shared_prefix) instead of the user message so that verifier chunks reuse a single cache entry.
A single-source structural invariant (prompts.shared_plan_prefix) must emit the shared prefix to prevent drift and enforce byte-identity across finder and both verifier templates.
An exhaustiveness directive bullet must be added to the shared preamble so every Pass-1 entry point (finder, container, ISF) instructs enumeration of all independent defects in the current run.
The Pass-1 warm gate must measure the actual cached bytes (shared_plan_prefix tokens, not plan tokens alone) to correctly compare against CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS.

The verifier templates must remove the volatile marker and plan variable, relegating the per-run finding listing to the user message (instructions) while the shared prefix becomes the stable system head.
